description: Networks for the Networks tab: DESeq2's results for the airway experiment, the STRING network of the genes it found changed (padj < 0.01, |log2FoldChange| >= 1.5), and Zachary's karate club.

airway_deseq2.csv.what: DESeq2's results, dexamethasone-treated against untreated airway smooth muscle cells: 22,369 genes (those with at least 10 reads in all), ordered by padj
airway_deseq2.csv.made: In the workbench itself (webR 0.6.0, R 4.6.0, DESeq2 1.52.0, locfit 1.5-9.12), by the steps 5 to 7 of the help's RNA-seq recipe (h-recipe-rnaseq), on 13 October 2026
airway_deseq2.csv.code: counts <- as.matrix(read.delim("/data/examples/rnaseq/airway_counts.tsv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)); samples <- read.delim("/data/examples/rnaseq/airway_samples.tsv", row.names = 1); samples <- samples[colnames(counts), ]; samples$cell <- factor(samples$cell); samples$dex <- factor(samples$dex, levels = c("untrt", "trt")); library(DESeq2); dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts, colData = samples, design = ~ cell + dex); dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10, ]; dds <- DESeq(dds); res <- results(dds, contrast = c("dex", "trt", "untrt"), alpha = 0.05); top <- as.data.frame(res[order(res$padj), ]); write.csv(top, "deseq2_dex_vs_untreated.csv")

airway_string_nodes.tsv.what: STRING's identifiers of the genes of airway_deseq2.csv with padj < 0.01 and |log2FoldChange| >= 1.5 (409 genes, sent in the order of the table): 357 found
airway_string_nodes.tsv.request: POST https://string-db.org/api/json/get_string_ids with identifiers = the 409 Ensembl gene IDs (separated by carriage returns), species = 9606, limit = 1, echo_query = 1, caller_identity = bioinformatics_workbench
airway_string_nodes.tsv.transformation: None: the answer (JSON) written as a tab-separated table with STRING's own columns (queryIndex, queryItem, stringId, preferredName, ncbiTaxonId, taxonName, annotation)
airway_string_nodes.tsv.not found: 52 of the 409 IDs: 33 long non-coding RNAs, 4 pseudogenes, 1 protein-coding gene, and 14 IDs no longer in Ensembl (Ensembl REST lookup/id, 13 October 2026)

airway_string_network.tsv.what: The associations among those 357 proteins with a combined score of at least 0.4: 512
airway_string_network.tsv.source: STRING 12.5 API, 13 October 2026, a second after the request above
airway_string_network.tsv.request: POST https://string-db.org/api/json/network with identifiers = the 357 stringIds of airway_string_nodes.tsv (separated by carriage returns), species = 9606, required_score = 400, network_type = functional (the default), caller_identity = bioinformatics_workbench
airway_string_network.tsv.transformation: None: the answer (JSON) written as a tab-separated table with STRING's own columns (stringId_A, stringId_B, preferredName_A, preferredName_B, ncbiTaxonId, score and the channel scores nscore, fscore, pscore, ascore, escore, dscore, tscore)

karate_club.graphml.what: Zachary's karate club: 34 members, 78 pairs who met outside the club, and the side each member joined (club: Mr. Hi or Officer)
karate_club.graphml.code: import networkx as nx; K = nx.karate_club_graph(); G = nx.Graph(name="Zachary's karate club"); [G.add_node(str(v + 1), name=str(v + 1), club=d["club"]) for v, d in K.nodes(data=True)]; [G.add_edge(str(u + 1), str(v + 1)) for u, v in K.edges()]; nx.write_graphml(G, "karate_club.graphml")
karate_club.graphml.transformation: The members numbered 1 to 34 as in Zachary's paper (NetworkX numbers them 0 to 33); NetworkX's edge weights left out. Running the code gives this file byte for byte.
